Hi, I’m Salman Farzi. I’m a full-stack website and mobile app developer helping entrepreneurs, startups, and small businesses turn raw concepts into functional, revenue-ready digital products.

Most business owners waste weeks coordinating between graphic designers, frontend coders, backend specialists, and cloud setup teams. That friction inflates costs and causes delays.

I solve that by managing the entire lifecycle myself: from wireframes and interactive UI/UX to clean full-stack code, database configuration, app store submissions, and production launch. You get senior agency quality with the speed, dedication, and affordable economics of an independent builder.

HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

A clear, milestone-driven roadmap from day one.

No guessing games. Here is exactly how we take your project from an idea to production.

  1. 01

    Discovery & Scope Blueprint

    We unpack your goals, target audience, essential feature list, and timelines. You receive a fixed-scope roadmap and transparent quote.

  2. 02

    Wireframing & UI/UX Design

    We design clean, interactive screens for desktop and mobile. You review, click through, and approve the look and feel before coding begins.

  3. 03

    Agile Full-Stack Development

    Frontend meets backend. I build the logic, database, and integrations with periodic staging previews so you can test features as they are built.

  4. 04

    Rigorous Testing & QA

    Cross-browser checks, mobile responsiveness tests, form verifications, page-speed benchmarks, and security audits.

  5. 05

    Deployment & Handover

    We configure your custom domain, SSL certificate, cloud servers, and release to production or app stores—plus a guided walkthrough for you.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Everything you need to know before we get started.

Clear answers about timelines, process, billing, and ownership.

Why should I work with you instead of an agency or cheaper freelance marketplaces?

You work directly with the person designing, building, and launching your product. Clear project scopes, transparent pricing, and a single point of contact keep the work focused from planning through delivery.

Do you really handle both design and coding?

Yes. I manage the complete lifecycle: UI/UX design and prototypes, frontend and backend development, databases, testing, deployment, and post-launch support.

Who owns the code and intellectual property once the project is finished?

You do. 100%. Upon project completion and final payment, you receive complete ownership of all Figma designs, GitHub repositories, codebase assets, and cloud credentials. There are no licensing fees, hidden traps, or vendor lock-in.

How long does a typical project take from start to finish?

Timelines depend on scope, features, and feedback. After discovery, you receive a project roadmap with agreed milestones and a delivery estimate before development begins.

Can you help configure our domain, hosting, and App Store accounts?

Yes. Launch support includes domain and DNS configuration, SSL certificates, cloud hosting, deployment, and app store submissions where included in your agreed project scope.

What happens if something breaks or needs updating after launch?

Each package includes a post-launch support period. Ongoing maintenance can cover bug fixes, security updates, monitoring, backups, and additional features under an agreed support plan.
